title: Tanzanian Coconut Fish Soup
community: Swahili coast — the richer coastal fish soup
author: Chef Fatuma
desc: Tanzanian Coconut Fish Soup — a fragrant, rich soup of flaked fish in a coconut milk broth with ginger, lemon grass, and Zanzibar spices. The coastal version — richer, more fragrant, and deeply restorative.
longDesc: Coconut fish soup is the richer, more celebratory version of plain fish soup — the coconut milk adds depth and MCTs, lemon grass adds fragrance, and the result heals and satisfies simultaneously.
steps: Simmer fish with water, onion, garlic, ginger, lemon grass, turmeric for 20 minutes.
Remove fish. Flake meat. Discard bones and lemon grass.
Add coconut milk and tomatoes to broth. Simmer gently 8 minutes.
Return flaked fish. Add curry powder. Season.
Garnish with coriander. Serve with lime.
chefTips: Fish frames make the richest base.
Never boil after adding coconut milk.
cookingScience: See TZA080 and TZA026 for fish soup and coconut milk science.
sustainabilityTips: Fish frames and heads — sustainable zero-waste cooking.
culturalNote: Coconut fish soup is the healing food of Zanzibar's coastal communities — the soup mothers make when someone is unwell, that fishermen eat to restore strength.
